title: Law to auto-enroll homeowners in property tax payment plans
summary: This bill would require the Department of Finance to automatically enroll eligible homeowners in the city-created property tax payment plan with the lowest total cost, instead of requiring them to sign up. The department would have to notify each eligible person at least 60 days before the first payment is due and offer a clear way to opt out, with materials available in the city's designated languages. The law would take effect 120 days after enactment.
